name: shop.photosweat/remove-background
title: Photo Sweat Shop Image Tools
description: Remove photo backgrounds, or upscale 2x/4x, on one MCP endpoint. 10 free per day, then $0.01/image.

tools.name: remove_background
tools.description: Cut out the subject onto transparency, white, or any solid color. Takes about 10 s on a warm GPU. Returns the processed image in an image content block, at the input's pixel size (long edge clamped to 4096 px — a larger input comes back scaled down). Free tiers: 10/day per anonymous IP, 30/day with a key; $0.01 per image beyond that. The quota left is echoed in the result text.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image to process (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 10 MB). Use a hostname, not an IP literal.

image_base64.description: The image itself, base64-encoded (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 10 MB). A data-URI prefix (RFC 2397) is accepted. Provide either this or image_url.

wait.description: Seconds to block waiting for the result (1–25). Past 25 the honest answer is a 202 + status_url you poll yourself, because MCP hosts time tool calls out.

background.description: Transparent, white, or a custom color

format.description: JPEG is much smaller for opaque backgrounds; transparency requires PNG

tools.name: upscale
tools.description: Real-ESRGAN upscale; prefer 2x on text-heavy images. Takes about 46 s on a warm GPU (beta — no SLA). Returns the processed image in an image content block, at the input's pixel size (long edge clamped to 4096 px — a larger input comes back scaled down). 'scale' is nominal: the output's long edge is min(scale × the input's, 4096 px). Free tiers: 10/day per anonymous IP, 30/day with a key; $0.01 per image beyond that. The quota left is echoed in the result text. A job that outruns the wait comes back as a status_url to poll.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image to process (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 10 MB). Use a hostname, not an IP literal.

image_base64.description: The image itself, base64-encoded (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 10 MB). A data-URI prefix (RFC 2397) is accepted. Provide either this or image_url.

wait.description: Seconds to block waiting for the result (1–25). Past 25 the honest answer is a 202 + status_url you poll yourself, because MCP hosts time tool calls out.

engine.description: Pick x4plus for text-heavy images: less halo and stroke adhesion

verifyText.description: Optional: OCR before/after and report missing or changed text. ~+5s on sparse text, up to +30s when text is dense
